bio: One of the finest luxury Surrey Hotels, Brooklands prides itself on personality, individuality, and an unparalleled level of service. With an iconic, art deco inspired interior and the world's most historic motor racing track running through the reception; the Brooklands Hotel has to be seen to be believed.  With a ultra-modern setting; 1907 restaurant, bar & grill is found within the Brooklands Hotel. Housed adjacent to Britain's most iconic race track, glitzy fittings and plush leather are offset by original chequered flags from the trackside. Blending classic Art Deco style with contemporary flourishes, 1907 Restaurant, Bar & Grill evokes a fashionable ambience where Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed.  If the sun is shining you can enjoy the traditionally English delight of Afternoon Tea in the outdoor patio area, perfect for a special occasion.
